about.name: Samaveda Chapter 1
about.description: The opening section of the Samaveda focusing on musical chanting of Vedic hymns.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवम् ऋत्विजम् होतारं रत्नधातमम्
verses.transliteration: agnim īḷe purohitaṁ yajñasya devam ṛtvijam hotāraṁ ratnadhātamam
verses.meaning: I praise Agni, the priest of the sacrifice, divine minister, who bestows treasures.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः पूर्वेभिरृषिभिरीड्यो नूतनैरुत स देवाँ एह वक्षति
verses.transliteration: agniḥ pūrvebhir ṛṣibhir īḍyo nūtanair uta sa devāṁ eha vakṣati
verses.meaning: Agni, praised by ancient and modern sages, brings the gods here.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निना रयिमश्नवत् पोषमेव दिवे-दिवे यशसं वीरवत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: agninā rayim aśnavat poṣam eva dive-dive yaśasaṁ vīravattamam
verses.meaning: Through Agni one gains wealth, nourishment, and glory day by day.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने यं यज्ञमध्वरं विश्वतः परिभूरसि स इद्देवेषु गच्छति
verses.transliteration: agne yaṁ yajñam adhvaraṁ viśvataḥ paribhūr asi sa id deveṣu gacchati
verses.meaning: Agni protects the sacrifice from all sides and carries it to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता कविक्रतुः सत्यश्चित्रश्रवस्तमः देवो देवेभिरा गमत्
verses.transliteration: agnir hotā kavikratuḥ satyaś citraśravastamaḥ devo devebhir ā gamat
verses.meaning: Agni, wise and truthful priest, comes with the gods.

verses.sanskrit: यदङ्ग दाशुषे त्वमग्ने भद्रं करिष्यसि तवेत्तत्सत्यमङ्गिरः
verses.transliteration: yadaṅga dāśuṣe tvam agne bhadraṁ kariṣyasi tavet tat satyam aṅgiraḥ
verses.meaning: O Agni, whatever good you will do for the worshipper—that indeed is true.

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वाग्ने दिवे-दिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम् नमो भरन्त एमसि
verses.transliteration: upa tvāgne dive-dive doṣāvastar dhiyā vayam namo bharanta emasi
verses.meaning: Day by day we approach you, O Agni, bringing our homage with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: राजन्तमध्वराणां गोपामृतस्य दीदिविम् वर्धमानं स्वे दमे
verses.transliteration: rājantam adhvarāṇāṁ gopām ṛtasya dīdivim vardhamānaṁ sve dame
verses.meaning: Agni shines as the lord of sacrifices, guardian of truth, growing in his own home.

verses.sanskrit: स नः पितेव सूनवे अग्ने सुपायनो भव सचस्वा नः स्वस्तये
verses.transliteration: sa naḥ piteva sūnave agne supāyano bhava sacasvā naḥ svastaye
verses.meaning: Like a father to his son, O Agni, be easy to approach and grant us well-being.

verses.sanskrit: वायवायाहि दर्शतेमे सोमा अरंकृताः तेषां पाहि श्रुधी हवम्
verses.transliteration: vāyav ā yāhi darśata ime somā araṁkṛtāḥ teṣāṁ pāhi śrudhī havam
verses.meaning: O Vayu, come to us; these Soma offerings are prepared. Drink them and hear our call.

verses.sanskrit: वायो तव प्रपृञ्चती धेनुर्जिगाति दाशुषे उरूची सोमपीतये
verses.transliteration: vāyo tava prapṛñcatī dhenur jigāti dāśuṣe urūcī somapītaye
verses.meaning: O Vayu, the offering flows toward you like a cow to its calf for drinking Soma.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू इमे सुता उप प्रयः सधस्थ आ गतम् इन्दवो वामुशन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: indra-vāyū ime sutā upa prayah sadhasthe ā gatam indavo vām uśanti hi
verses.meaning: O Indra and Vayu, come to this sacred place; the Soma juices long for you.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः अस्माकमस्तु केवलः
verses.transliteration: indraṁ vo viśvatas pari havāmahe janebhyaḥ asmākam astu kevalaḥ
verses.meaning: We invoke Indra from all directions; may he be solely ours for protection.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वः सुतपा इमं स्तोमं यज्ञस्य धीयते उप ब्रह्माणि वक्षतः
verses.transliteration: indraṁ vaḥ sutapā imaṁ stomaṁ yajñasya dhīyate upa brahmāṇi vakṣataḥ
verses.meaning: Offer this hymn to Indra, the Soma-drinker; let the sacred chants carry it to him.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय गायत नरो गीर्भिः स्तोमैः अवस्यवः स नो विश्वा अभि द्विषः
verses.transliteration: indrāya gāyata naro gīrbhiḥ stomaiḥ avasyavaḥ sa no viśvā abhi dviṣaḥ
verses.meaning: Sing to Indra with hymns; may he help us overcome all enemies.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं नरो नेमधिता हवामहे यः पार्थिवानि विममे रजांसि
verses.transliteration: indraṁ naro nemadhitā havāmahe yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṁsi
verses.meaning: We invoke Indra, who has measured out the earthly regions and grants protection.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः सुतपा वृषभो न भीमः शत्रून् जघान पुरुहूत उग्रः
verses.transliteration: indraḥ sutapā vṛṣabho na bhīmaḥ śatrūn jaghāna puruhūta ugraḥ
verses.meaning: Indra, powerful and fierce, destroys enemies like a mighty bull.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोमं सुषुतं मदाय पिबा वज्रिन् हरिभिः सुतस्य
verses.transliteration: indrāya somaṁ suṣutaṁ madāya pibā vajrin haribhiḥ sutasya
verses.meaning: O Indra, drink the well-prepared Soma for delight, O wielder of the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये विश्वान् भोगान् ददाति नः
verses.transliteration: indraḥ somasya pītaye viśvān bhogān dadāti naḥ
verses.meaning: Indra grants all enjoyments and rewards through the Soma offering.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन् समुद्रं न सिन्धवः रथीतमं रथीनाम्
verses.transliteration: indraṁ viśvā avīvṛdhan samudraṁ na sindhavaḥ rathītamaṁ rathīnām
verses.meaning: All powers magnify Indra like rivers fill the ocean; he is the greatest among leaders.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वो वीरं हवामहे सखा यज्ञस्य सुव्रतं
verses.transliteration: indraṁ vo vīraṁ havāmahe sakhā yajñasya suvrataṁ
verses.meaning: We invoke Indra, the heroic one, the faithful companion of the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: स नः पातु इन्द्रः सर्वतः शत्रून् हन्तु वज्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: sa naḥ pātu indraḥ sarvataḥ śatrūn hantu vajribhiḥ
verses.meaning: May Indra protect us from all sides and strike down enemies with his thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय हव्यम् वहत स्तोमं च गायत
verses.transliteration: indrāya havyam vahata stomaṁ ca gāyata
verses.meaning: Carry the offering to Indra and sing the sacred hymn to him.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः नो रयिम् ददातु वाजं च वीर्यं महत्
verses.transliteration: indraḥ no rayim dadātu vājaṁ ca vīryaṁ mahat
verses.meaning: May Indra grant us wealth, strength, and great vitality.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा वज्रिन् हवामहे शृणु नः स्तोमम् इन्द्र
verses.transliteration: ā tvā vajrin havāmahe śṛṇu naḥ stomam indra
verses.meaning: We call upon you, O thunderbolt-wielding Indra—hear our hymn.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र श्रुधि नः स्तोमं हवम् एतं च सुक्रतो
verses.transliteration: indra śrudhi naḥ stomaṁ havam etaṁ ca sukrato
verses.meaning: O Indra, hear our hymn and this offering, O wise one.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय गायत स्तोमं यज्ञस्य साधनम्
verses.transliteration: indrāya gāyata stomaṁ yajñasya sādhanam
verses.meaning: Sing the hymn to Indra, the accomplisher of the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तो अप्तुरः कृण्वाना यज्ञमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: indraṁ vardhanto apturaḥ kṛṇvānā yajñam uttamam
verses.meaning: Exalting Indra, we perform the supreme sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः शक्त्या नः पातु विजयं ददातु नः
verses.transliteration: indraḥ śaktyā naḥ pātu vijayaṁ dadātu naḥ
verses.meaning: May Indra protect us with strength and grant us victory.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः सोमं पिबतु मदाय यज्ञस्य फलदः
verses.transliteration: indraḥ somaṁ pibatu madāya yajñasya phaladaḥ
verses.meaning: May Indra drink the Soma with delight and grant the fruits of the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वः सखायो हवामहे वज्रिणं चर्षणीनाम्
verses.transliteration: indraṁ vaḥ sakhāyo havāmahe vajriṇaṁ carṣaṇīnām
verses.meaning: O friends, we invoke Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, protector of people.

verses.sanskrit: स नः पातु इन्द्रः सर्वतः शत्रून् हन्तु वज्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: sa naḥ pātu indraḥ sarvataḥ śatrūn hantu vajribhiḥ
verses.meaning: May Indra protect us from all sides and strike down enemies.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः शत्रून् जघान बलिना वज्रिणा नृभिः
verses.transliteration: indraḥ śatrūn jaghāna balinā vajriṇā nṛbhiḥ
verses.meaning: Indra, with his strength and thunderbolt, destroys enemies.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोमं सुतं वयं वहाम यज्ञस्य फलाय
verses.transliteration: indrāya somaṁ sutaṁ vayaṁ vahāma yajñasya phalāya
verses.meaning: We offer the prepared Soma to Indra for the fruit of the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः नः रयिं ददातु वीर्यं च महत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: indraḥ naḥ rayiṁ dadātu vīryaṁ ca mahattamam
verses.meaning: May Indra grant us wealth and great strength.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वः स्तोमैः हवामहे यो नः पातु सदावृधः
verses.transliteration: indraṁ vaḥ stomaiḥ havāmahe yo naḥ pātu sadāvṛdhaḥ
verses.meaning: We invoke Indra with hymns, who always protects and strengthens us.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः विश्वानि बलानि धारयति महता बलम्
verses.transliteration: indraḥ viśvāni balāni dhārayati mahatā balam
verses.meaning: Indra sustains all powers with his great strength.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः शत्रून् अभिभूत्य जयति वज्रिणा
verses.transliteration: indraḥ śatrūn abhibhūtya jayati vajriṇā
verses.meaning: Indra conquers enemies and attains victory with his thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः नः श्रेयः ददातु आयुः च वर्धयतु
verses.transliteration: indraḥ naḥ śreyaḥ dadātu āyuḥ ca vardhayatu
verses.meaning: May Indra grant us prosperity and increase our lifespan.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोमं पिबाम यज्ञस्य सिद्धये
verses.transliteration: indrāya somaṁ pibāma yajñasya siddhaye
verses.meaning: We offer Soma to Indra for the successful completion of the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं हवामहे पुनः बलाय च विजयाय च
verses.transliteration: indraṁ havāmahe punaḥ balāya ca vijayāya ca
verses.meaning: We invoke Indra again for strength and victory.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः नः पातु सर्वतः वज्रेण शत्रून् हन्तु
verses.transliteration: indraḥ naḥ pātu sarvataḥ vajreṇa śatrūn hantu
verses.meaning: May Indra protect us and destroy enemies with his thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः बलं ददातु नः महद् वीर्यं च वर्धयेत्
verses.transliteration: indraḥ balaṁ dadātu naḥ mahad vīryaṁ ca vardhayet
verses.meaning: May Indra grant us strength and increase our power.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः जयति शत्रून् सर्वान् अभिभूत्य
verses.transliteration: indraḥ jayati śatrūn sarvān abhibhūtya
verses.meaning: Indra conquers all enemies with dominance.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः नः श्रेयः करोतु धनं च वर्धयतु
verses.transliteration: indraḥ naḥ śreyaḥ karotu dhanaṁ ca vardhayatu
verses.meaning: May Indra bring us prosperity and increase our wealth.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः महद् बलं धारयति सर्वेषां नायकः
verses.transliteration: indraḥ mahad balaṁ dhārayati sarveṣāṁ nāyakaḥ
verses.meaning: Indra holds great strength and is the leader of all.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः नः मार्गं दर्शयतु रक्षतु च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: indraḥ naḥ mārgaṁ darśayatu rakṣatu ca sarvataḥ
verses.meaning: May Indra show us the path and protect us from all sides.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं पुनः हवामहे यज्ञस्य मूलं
verses.transliteration: agniṁ punaḥ havāmahe yajñasya mūlam
verses.meaning: We again invoke Agni, the foundation of the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः नः पुनरावर्तयतु जीवनं च शक्तिम्
verses.transliteration: agniḥ naḥ punarāvartayatu jīvanaṁ ca śaktim
verses.meaning: May Agni renew our life and strength.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः सर्वस्य मूलं धारयति विश्वं
verses.transliteration: agniḥ sarvasya mūlaṁ dhārayati viśvam
verses.meaning: Agni sustains the foundation of all existence.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः स्थिरं बलं ददातु नः
verses.transliteration: agniḥ sthiraṁ balaṁ dadātu naḥ
verses.meaning: May Agni grant us stable strength.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने पावक पावय नः सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: agne pāvaka pāvaya naḥ sarvataḥ
verses.meaning: O purifying Agni, cleanse us from all sides.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः नः रक्षतु सर्वतः भयात्
verses.transliteration: agniḥ naḥ rakṣatu sarvataḥ bhayāt
verses.meaning: May Agni protect us from all fear.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः ऊर्जा ददातु नः
verses.transliteration: agniḥ ūrjā dadātu naḥ
verses.meaning: May Agni grant us energy.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः वर्धयतु नः जीवनम्
verses.transliteration: agniḥ vardhayatu naḥ jīvanam
verses.meaning: May Agni increase our life and growth.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः नः पातु सततम्
verses.transliteration: agniḥ naḥ pātu satatam
verses.meaning: May Agni protect us continuously.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः बलं स्थिरं ददातु
verses.transliteration: agniḥ balaṁ sthiraṁ dadātu
verses.meaning: May Agni grant stable strength.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः प्रकाशं ददातु नः
verses.transliteration: agniḥ prakāśaṁ dadātu naḥ
verses.meaning: May Agni grant us light and clarity.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः नः मार्गं दर्शयतु
verses.transliteration: agniḥ naḥ mārgaṁ darśayatu
verses.meaning: May Agni show us the right path.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः पुनरावर्तयतु जीवनं बलं च
verses.transliteration: agniḥ punarāvartayatu jīvanaṁ balaṁ ca
verses.meaning: May Agni renew life and strength again.
